overview: The Palace Garden Terraces are the ceremonial and scenic gardens surrounding Shar Vahl’s palace.
history: The terraces were planted to symbolize unity between clans and the royal line.
Ceremonial flora was cultivated for rites and diplomatic gatherings.
Elevated walkways were added to connect the gardens to the palace balconies.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the terraces were expanded with new scenic overlooks.
Shadow-Threat Watch installed subtle arcane sensors to monitor disturbances.
hooks: A ceremonial blossom blooms out of season, hinting at arcane influence.
A garden hazard disrupts a diplomatic stroll.
A rare plant goes missing from the ritual grove.
A terrace walkway destabilizes during a royal gathering.
